description: Valid values for the enumerated filters on California municipal bond issuance search — debt types, purposes, issuer groups and types, counties, tax statuses, ESG labels, sale types, credit enhancement types and sold status. Call this when a search filter returns no rows to see the exact wording CDIAC uses.

field.description: One of: debt_type, primary_purpose, issuer_group, issuer_type, county, tax_status, sold_status, labeled_debt_type, sale_type, source_of_repayment, enhancement_type, interest_type. Omit for all.

name: ca_debt_filter_options
title: Ca Debt Filter Options
